flags.issue: Broker tracks only same-account, identical-CUSIP wash sales. Ask about purchases in IRAs (loss permanently disallowed), spouse's accounts, other brokers and options on the same securities.
1 wash line(s) have a disallowed amount larger than the line's own loss (broker aggregation). Reported as the broker computed.
1 unknown-term lot(s): holding period AND basis must come from the client before entry.
Box B: 1 lot(s) with no basis on the 1099; client must supply basis and date acquired.
Box B: 2 lot(s) basis not reported to IRS: enter each lot individually and verify basis with the client.
Box E: 1 lot(s) basis not reported to IRS: enter each lot individually and verify basis with the client.
Box H: 1 lot(s) with no basis on the 1099; client must supply basis and date acquired.
Box H: 1 lot(s) basis not reported to IRS: enter each lot individually and verify basis with the client.
Noncovered 1099-DA lots (Box H/K): basis comes from broker records only; request support.
Digital asset transactions present: answer YES to the Form 1040 digital asset question.
ABC CORP CVR: CVR with zero/no basis; confirm basis allocation with the client.
1099-MISC box 8 substitute payments are ordinary income, not qualified dividends.

Holding-period screen: lots held 60 days or less straddle qualified dividend payments (APPLE INC, SPDR S&P 500 ETF TRUST). Ex-date is not on the 1099; ask whether other shares were held through year-end.
Section 1256 aggregate profit/(loss) goes to Form 6781 (60/40), not Form 8949.
Margin interest goes to Form 4952: check net investment income and ask whether the client elects to treat qualified dividends/gains as investment income.
ADR and other investment fees are not deductible.
U.S. Treasury / direct federal obligation interest is a state subtraction in most states (including Colorado).
Confirm there are no separate joint, retirement or other-broker 1099s for this client.
